name: stories

frames.best_why: Three full cards and part of a fourth read cleanly, with no cursor over the author rows.

tagline: Row of tall photo cards with a small avatar and name at the foot.
summary: A sideways strip of portrait story cards. Each holds a photo or a looping clip that plays on hover, with a dark gradient at the bottom behind the author's avatar and name.
appearance: A row of tall rounded cards in a three-to-four ratio, each filled edge to edge with a photograph and a soft dark gradient along the bottom. Within the gradient a small round avatar sits beside a white name.
behaviour: The strip scrolls freely by dragging sideways and is cut off at the right edge. Hovering or focusing a card lifts it slightly and starts its video, which pauses and rewinds when the pointer or focus leaves.
demo_content: Mountain, forest and flower photos credited to Maya Chen, Leo Park, Priya Nair and Tom Becker.
search_phrases: horizontal row of photo story cards
avatar and name on photo tiles
portrait media cards in a line
use_when: A feed has many short visual updates that people should browse sideways without leaving the page.
avoid_when: Videos only play on hover or focus, so on touch screens the clips stay as stills and nothing plays by itself.
customise: Cards are composed from the exported parts, with image or video source, author name and avatar given as props; width and aspect come from class names you set.
weight_why: Several remote images plus hover-played videos, though nothing animates until a card is hovered.

a11y.note: Cards are only identified by their author text, and the playing videos have no captions or description.

issues: All six frames look almost the same, so the hover zoom and video playback never really appear.
The final card is clipped at the right edge, leaving its author cut off.
polish_why: Strong photo treatment and a tidy author row, but the clip never shows the video idea in motion.
title: Stories
